text:
maria.dev: Heads-up: user reported sample app failing when token expires; seems only the Ruby SDK doesn't auto-retry after a 401. Repro steps below and a tiny log snippet.

maria.dev: Repro (local):
1) start sample app with short-lived token
2) wait for expiry
3) call /generate -> gets 401 -> SDK surfaces error, app fails (JS SDK does refresh+retry)

maria.dev: logs:
```
I, [2026-02-20T15:12:03.123Z]  INFO -- request: POST /v1/generate
E, [2026-02-20T15:12:03.456Z] ERROR -- response: 401 {"error":"invalid_token"}
E, [2026-02-20T15:12:03.457Z] ERROR -- ruby-sdk: raise AuthError -> returned to caller
```

maria.dev: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/82 — adds auto-refresh+retry to match JS behavior.

timothyk: ah — we intentionally left refresh out of the retry loop originally to avoid duplicate refreshes under concurrency. But parity with JS makes sense. Can you paste the exact request headers and the PR diff for the retry loop? :thinking:

maria.dev: PR diff excerpt:
```ruby
# new behavior in client.rb
def with_auth_retry
  yield
rescue AuthError => e
  if config.auto_refresh
    refresh_token_once_with_lock
    retry
  else
    raise
  end
end
```

sanjay: skimmed the PR — two nits: (1) current backoff is a fixed sleep(1) in the retry — prefer exponential backoff with jitter to avoid thundering herd, (2) make sure this honors the existing `max_retries` config instead of unbounded retries. Also add a test for concurrent callers hitting a 401 to ensure only one refresh happens.

maria.dev: thanks — added exponential + jitter and wired into max_retries in the next commit. CI is failing on a flakey spec in GH Actions though, looks unrelated to logic. @ci-bot any logs?

ci-bot: CI: failed on matrix job ruby-3.1 / ubuntu-latest — bundler install timed out, retry suggested. Re-run? :repeat:

timothyk: I'll take CI flakes — running a re-run and investigating the bundler timeouts. For the SDK change, we need to mark this as opt-out (safer): default `auto_refresh: true` but allow `auto_refresh: false` to preserve old behavior for customers. Also update CHANGELOG noting behavioral change.

devx-mgr: Important: this is a behavior change for customers who explicitly call refresh flows. Please add a migration note in docs and an env var flag `REDWOOD_RUBY_AUTO_REFRESH=false` that can override config for quick rollbacks. Also add an entry to the sample app showing how to opt-out.

maria.dev: added docs + migration note in the PR, and included a sample snippet in samples/simple_app.rb showing usage: `client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'], auto_refresh: false)` — pushed.

sanjay: Looks good. Approving once CI is green. :thumbsup:
